facet_lens: Can this actually be operated? DR drills feasible? Bootstrap from zero hardware works? On-call playbooks exist? Tenant migration runbooks? Cell self-retirement? Failure modes have defined responses?
corpus_reviewed: microservices/community/PRD.md (ops sections, AC-21 DR drill, §12.2 SLO floor)
verdict_rationale: Doctrine is operationally coherent at the architecture layer (bootstrap sequence is explicit, cell self-retirement is documented, DR tier framework is enumerated, deployment spectrum has discrete SLO+support per model, failure-mode catalog in ADR-0247 §D-12 is real). However, the bundle ships with material runbook + procedure debt that blocks day-one operability: 9 promised runbooks/procedures are referenced as deliverables but not present in /docs/runbooks/, the cross-tenant restore + tenant migration mechanics are specified but lack an operator runbook, the bootstrap-recovery drill cadence is undeclared, on-call coverage for the new µservices (deployment-control-plane, portability-export/import) has no rotation declared, and PRD-side ops sections for Mail/Messenger/Community are thin to absent on incident response, capacity planning, and migration playbooks. The doctrine is ship-worthy as text; the runbook surface that lets a 3am SRE actually operate it is not.

bootstrap_from_zero_hardware.evidence: ADR-0247 §D-5 enumerates 5 stages (Stage 0 external prep → Stage 1 external CI kubeadm → Stage 2 substrate self-host → Stage 3 bootstrap cell self-retire → Stage 4 steady state); ADR-0242 §D-5 enumerates 10 numbered steps with chicken-and-egg resolutions; ADR-0248 §D-2 documents bootstrap cell self-retirement (6 sub-steps including etcd snapshot sealing). Intern day-one runbook proves the local-kind variant works at single-laptop scale.
gaps: Stage 1 time budget claim '≤ 8 hours' is unsubstantiated — no actual timed dry-run is cited.
Stage 0.5 'bootstrap-replay log' format is not specified (what schema, signed by what key before audit-chain exists, where stored).
Stage 3.2 'workflows scheduled on bootstrap cell migrate to dev-tools-cell-prod' has no defined drain protocol for in-flight workflows.
No documented recovery procedure if Stage 1 external CI runner fails mid-sequence (partial-bootstrap state).

dr_drill_feasibility.evidence: ADR-0241 defines 4 DR tiers with explicit RTO/RPO + drill cadence (T1/T2 quarterly, T3/T4 semi-annual); drill mechanics §D-3 require functional+performance+data+audit gates; orchestrator location specified (microservices/cloud-iac/src/dr_drill_orchestrator.rs); D-6 catalogs 7 business-continuity scenarios with cadence.
gaps: dr_drill_orchestrator.rs is BACKLOG (registry/dr/orchestrator-backlog.tsv) — no implementation, no drill has ever run.

ADR-0241 §D-3 specifies emit audit-chain class DrDrillReceipt but no drill-runbook template per tier exists in docs/runbooks/dr-drill-playbook.md (one file present but not validated against the 4-tier matrix).
Cross-tier coordination rule (T1 µservice depending on T2 must tolerate degraded dep per §D-5) requires brown-out signal integration (ADR-0176) — no test scenario exercising this.
Quarterly regulator evidence packet (DrBcQuarterlyEvidence) emission flow not implemented; ops-compliance owner does not yet have the assembly pipeline.

on_call_playbooks.evidence: docs/runbooks/ has 100+ existing runbooks including foundry-*, cell-*, audit-chain-*, dr-drill-playbook.md, security-incident-response.md, sev1-incident-response.md, on-call-handover.md, region-failover.md. Intern day-one §8 defines the 4-tier escalation chain (mentor → axis lead → council → ops-sre-reliability on-call) and references /ops/runbooks/oncall-rotation.md.
gaps: /ops/runbooks/oncall-rotation.md is referenced but not present in tree.

NEW µservices introduced by the keystone bundle have no incident-response runbook: deployment-control-plane (ADR-0254), portability-export, portability-import (ADR-0276), policy-engine substrate-promotion specifics (ADR-0246), bootstrap-cell (no oyatie-bootstrap-recovery.md per ADR-0247 §1107 promise).
Self-modification failure modes (ADR-0247 §D-12) reference docs/runbooks/self-modification-incident-response.md and docs/runbooks/oyatie-bootstrap-recovery.md — both listed as NEW (not yet created).
No runbook for the 'kill-switch' Cedar emergency-forbid fragment activation (ADR-0247 §D-1 supervisor BC); supervisor-side kill protocol is unspecified at operator level.
Tier 4 ops-sre on-call has no SLO published for response time on a day-one intern-impacting event.

tenant_migration_runbooks.evidence: ADR-0276 §D-10 specifies cross-tenant restore mechanics (Cedar source consent + destination acceptance + principal mapping + data-class scope + audit-chain disposition); D-12 commits 5+ year re-import compat; ADR-0248 §D-12 declares shuffle-sharding migration ChangeSet pattern; docs/runbooks/tenant-onboarding.md + cross-pack-tenant-residency.md + tenant-escalation-management.md present.
gaps: No runbook for the 4 named cross-tenant restore stories (B2C→B2B upgrade, agency handoff, M&A consolidation, DR-style restore under new ID). ADR-0276 names them but operator procedure absent.
Shuffle-sharding rebind during cell auto-spawn at 70% (ADR-0248 §D-10) — no runbook for the 'planned migration' that ADR-0248 §D-12 promises but does not author.
BYOC onboarding (ADR-0254 §D-1.3) requires IAM-delegated access flow + tenant-cloud OpenTofu execution + cell deployment + cutover — no end-to-end playbook.
On-prem air-gapped tenant bootstrap (ADR-0254 §D-1.5) needs CDS-handoff procedure, key-ceremony procedure, bundle ingestion procedure — none present in docs/runbooks/.
Tenant exit / DSAR-Article-17 full-erasure cascade (ADR-0242 Appendix B worked example) has no per-µservice operator playbook; only the architectural sequence is given.

cell_self_retirement.evidence: ADR-0248 §D-2 documents 7-step bootstrap cell self-retirement (audit-chain emit → migrate oyatie home_cell → drain → namespace teardown → etcd snapshot to OpenBao → cluster deprovision → receipt artifact). ADR-0247 §3.0–3.4 mirrors this. Cell decommissioning at <20% util for 7 days documented (ADR-0248 §D-10).
gaps: No retirement drill has been executed (admission gate condition #3 of ADR-0248 demands 'bootstrap cell self-retirement procedure has been exercised end-to-end on a clean install with audit-chain evidence replay' — not yet satisfied).
BootstrapCellRetirementReceipt artifact format unspecified beyond 'Merkle proof of the retirement audit-chain segment'.
Failure scenario: what if Stage 3.3 cluster deprovisioning fails after Stage 3.2 drain completes? No rollback path.
Operator-facing /docs/runbooks/cell-retirement.md absent; only cell-provision.md + cell-failover-intra-region.md present.

failure_mode_response.evidence: ADR-0247 §D-12 catalogs 4 failure modes (bad workflow version, bad Cedar fragment, bad substrate version, broken rollback-controller) with severity × scope matrix and named response. Per-mode includes Manual bootstrap replay path (docs/runbooks/oyatie-bootstrap-recovery.md). ADR-0241 §D-5 degraded-dependency rule + brown-out signal (ADR-0176) handles cross-tier T1↔T2 failure propagation. ADR-0248 §D-8 24-hour static stability per tier.
gaps: Failure mode 4 (rollback-controller itself broken) escalates to docs/runbooks/oyatie-bootstrap-recovery.md which does not exist yet.
Cedar fragment bad-publication (Failure mode 2): the meta-permit fragment requires 3 human approvers per ADR-0247 §D-8 — but if the meta-permit fragment itself is broken, the recovery path is silent.

Deployment-control-plane (ADR-0254) failure modes are not enumerated: what happens when bundle distribution endpoint is unreachable for >24h? when cosign trust root is rotated mid-air-gapped-window? when canary controller wedges between SLO breach detection and rollback?
Backup/portability failure modes (ADR-0276) not catalogued: corrupt manifest, mid-export tenant data mutation, signature key rotation during long export.

observability_coverage.evidence: ADR-0241 §D-7 mandates per-µservice DR tier dashboard at microservices/observability/dashboards/dr-business-continuity.md; ADR-0248 §5 demands cellular-topology dashboard; ADR-0242 §Implementation surface lists observability/dashboards/oyatie-tenant.md; intern-day-one §3 gives operator-level signal verification (rollout status, audit-chain query).
gaps: All four dashboards are listed as NEW deliverables; none exist in the tree.
Per-cell static-stability tolerance gauge (ADR-0248 §D-8: SEV-3 at 1h, SEV-2 at 6h, SEV-1 at 12h, SEV-0 at 24h Tier 2 isolation) — no alerting rule authored.
Cross-tenant restore SLO (ADR-0276 30-day GDPR + 7-day internal target) — no error-budget dashboard or burn-rate alert defined.
Tier 2→Tier 3 snapshot pull latency (ADR-0248 §D-9 constant-work 30s Cedar bundle, hourly tenant snapshot) — no synthetic probe or alert.

capacity_planning.evidence: ADR-0248 §D-10 defines 100-300 tenant/cell sizing, 70% utilization auto-spawn trigger, 7-day <20% util decommissioning; Tier 2 sizing envelope (10k-50k tenants, 50k-200k Cedar evals/s, 1-5PB ledger). Stripe Cells 2024 citation gives 1k-10k tenant per payment-grade cell.
gaps: No capacity model for the dev-tools-cell (ADR-0247 §D-6 dev/staging/prod) — how many PRs/hour can prod handle?
Auto-spawn workflow named (ops-dr-capacity + axis-cell owners, docs/runbooks/cell-tier-3-auto-spawn.md) but file not present.
Air-gapped deployment capacity bounds undeclared (ADR-0254 §D-15 references hardware spec but section is past the read window).
Burst capacity for emergency security bundle distribution (ADR-0254 §D-7: <4h shared, <72h air-gapped) — no surge-capacity model.

runbook_coverage.notes: ADR-0242 §Implementation surface + ADR-0247 §Implementation surface both promise these as NEW deliverables. Without them, the bootstrap sequence is read-only doctrine; no operator can execute it under pressure.
7 sub-steps documented inline; no standalone runbook; no drill record (admission gate condition #3 not satisfied).
Referenced 5 times across ADR-0247 + ADR-0242 as the canonical last-resort recovery. Absence is the single highest-impact runbook gap in the bundle.
ADR-0247 §D-12 names the 4 failure modes but operator-facing response sequence is not documented; auto-rollback-controller path assumes the controller itself is healthy.

runbook_coverage.scenario: DR drill execution per tier (T1 quarterly, T2 quarterly, T3 semi-annual, T4 semi-annual)
runbook_coverage.notes: File exists but not validated against the 4-tier matrix; dr_drill_orchestrator backlog means drills cannot be auto-orchestrated; quarterly DrBcQuarterlyEvidence emission flow unimplemented.

runbook_coverage.scenario: Cross-tenant restore (B2C→B2B, agency handoff, M&A, DR-restore-under-new-ID)
runbook_coverage.notes: ADR-0276 §D-10 specifies Cedar gates + principal mapping + audit disposition; no operator playbook walks the 4 named stories.
ADR-0254 ship-condition #3 demands per-cloud OpenTofu modules across 9 providers; without runbook, sales cannot estimate; engineering cannot quote a delivery date.

runbook_coverage.scenario: On-prem air-gapped bundle delivery (CDS one-way diode flow)
runbook_coverage.notes: ADR-0254 §D-6 specifies CDS topology + reverse-direction audit export. Operator-side scheduling, classification review, key-ceremony cadence absent.

runbook_coverage.notes: ADR-0242 §Implementation surface promises this NEW. The worked example spans 11 µservices; without operator playbook, the 30-day GDPR Article 12 SLA cannot be met under pressure.

runbook_coverage.notes: ADR-0248 §D-10 names ops-dr-capacity + axis-cell as owners. The capacity-monitor → provision → join → migrate flow is implementation-bound; no runbook.

ADR-0247 §D-1 references supervisor BC kill-switch as Cedar emergency-forbid fragment activation per ADR-0243 §Appendix B. Operator pre-conditions, approver set, hot-reload validation steps not in runbook form.
ADR-0254 §D-7 promises 5 distinct upgrade flows. The Flagger canary + SLO-gated promotion + auto-rollback procedures need per-model runbooks.

runbook_coverage.scenario: Portability bundle export + verify + import (cross-tenant + air-gapped)
runbook_coverage.notes: ADR-0276 §B worked example + §D-13 two-pass import resolution need operator-facing checklist (BYOK key ceremony, signature verification, 5+ year re-import drill cadence).
Intern day-one runbook walks all 5 variant attempts (oya-bad, oyatie-shadow, oyat-test, Oyatié, oуatie); only gap is no production-side smoke test scheduled.
Intern day-one §8 enumerates 4-tier escalation (mentor → axis lead → council → ops-sre-reliability on-call) but the actual rotation document is missing. Day-1 SRE incident has no defined responder.

top_findings.title: 9+ canonical runbooks referenced as deliverables across the keystone bundle do not exist in /docs/runbooks/
top_findings.evidence: ADR-0242 §Implementation surface lists oyatie-bootstrap-recovery.md + oyatie-dsar-cascade.md as NEW; ADR-0247 §1562-1563 lists oyatie-bootstrap-recovery.md + self-modification-incident-response.md as NEW; ADR-0248 §D-10 names cell-tier-3-auto-spawn.md as the auto-spawn owner runbook; ADR-0254 § implies BYOC + air-gap runbooks. None of these files exist in /docs/runbooks/. Bundle is text-shippable but not operator-shippable.
top_findings.remediation: Author the 9 highest-priority runbooks as a follow-on PR before any keystone validator gate promotes from advisory to BLOCKER. At minimum: oyatie-bootstrap-recovery.md, self-modification-incident-response.md, oyatie-dsar-cascade.md, oncall-rotation.md.

top_findings.title: Bootstrap cell self-retirement has never been drilled; admission gate condition #3 for ADR-0248 BLOCKER promotion is unsatisfied
top_findings.evidence: ADR-0248 §Status condition #3: 'The bootstrap cell self-retirement procedure (§D-2) has been exercised end-to-end on a clean install with audit-chain evidence replay.' No evidence in /evidence/ of any such drill. The 7-step retirement sequence is plausible but unvalidated.
top_findings.remediation: Execute a tabletop drill of the 7-step self-retirement sequence + capture BootstrapCellRetirementReceipt artifact in /evidence/bootstrap-cell-retirement-drill-2026-XX-XX.json before keystone validators promote to BLOCKER.

top_findings.title: On-call rotation document referenced but absent; new µservices have no incident-response runbook
top_findings.evidence: intern-day-one §8.4 references /ops/runbooks/oncall-rotation.md as the day-1 escalation target for production-impacting issues. File not present. Deployment-control-plane (ADR-0254), portability-export, portability-import (ADR-0276), and the dev-tools-cell-prod (ADR-0247) have no per-µservice on-call runbook authored.
top_findings.remediation: Author ops/runbooks/oncall-rotation.md naming responder rotation for the 6 new keystone-introduced surfaces; add per-µservice incident-response.md template for each new µservice.

top_findings.title: DR drill orchestrator is backlog; quarterly regulator evidence packet has no assembly pipeline
top_findings.evidence: ADR-0241 §Implementation surface notes microservices/cloud-iac/src/dr_drill_orchestrator.rs is BACKLOG tracked at registry/dr/orchestrator-backlog.tsv. DrBcQuarterlyEvidence emission flow (§D-8) names ops-compliance as the emitter but no script, no template, no cron. Without orchestrator, drills are manual; without emission flow, regulator evidence (CSAP, ISO 22301, SOC 2) is not automatic as ADR-0241 §C-1 claims.
top_findings.remediation: Either promote dr_drill_orchestrator.rs out of backlog (P0) or downgrade ADR-0241 §C-1 'Regulator evidence is automatic' claim to 'will be automatic post-implementation' — current text is aspirational not actual.

top_findings.title: Per-PRD ops sections for Mail/Messenger/Community are thin; only Community PRD has explicit DR drill + SLO floor
top_findings.evidence: Grep of mail/PRD.md for ops/sre/runbook/incident/failure/capacity/drill headings returns 1 hit ('migration from competitors' §4.11). Messenger/PRD.md returns 2 hits (multi-device backups §3.7, migration §4.10). Community/PRD.md is the only PRD with explicit §12.2 SLO floor + AC-21 DR drill quarterly cadence + AC-22 cell isolation chaos test. Mail and Messenger lack equivalent ops sections.
top_findings.remediation: Mandate per-PRD ops section template covering: SLO floor (read/write/realtime), DR tier declaration, capacity ceilings, incident-response link, migration playbook. Mail and Messenger PRDs require ops-section uplift before product-tier promotion.

top_findings.title: Cross-tenant restore for the 4 named stories has architectural spec but no operator playbook
top_findings.evidence: ADR-0276 §D-10 enumerates B2C-to-B2B migration, agency handoff, M&A, DR-style restore as the powered use cases. Cedar source-consent + destination-acceptance + principal-mapping + audit-chain disposition are specified. No per-story operator runbook walks the actual procedure.
top_findings.remediation: Author 4 per-story runbooks (or one consolidated cross-tenant-restore.md with named sub-sections) before ADR-0276 portability-substrate-lands validator promotes.

top_findings.title: Air-gapped IL5/6 + CDS delivery procedures specified at architecture layer; key ceremony + classification review + bundle ingestion cadence absent
top_findings.evidence: ADR-0254 §D-6 documents CDS one-way diode topology + reverse-channel audit export. Tenant-side procedures (CDS provider selection from NCDSMO approved list, classification review per tenant policy, removable-media chain-of-custody, key-ceremony cadence for offline DEK rotation) are referenced but not authored as operator runbooks.
top_findings.remediation: Author docs/runbooks/air-gap-bundle-delivery.md + air-gap-key-ceremony.md before any air-gapped customer engagement; required for ADR-0254 §Status condition #4 (at least one reference deployment of each model).

top_findings.title: Observability dashboards promised by 4 keystones not present in tree
top_findings.evidence: ADR-0241 §D-7 (dr-business-continuity.md), ADR-0248 §Status #5 (cellular-topology.md), ADR-0242 §Implementation surface (oyatie-tenant.md), implicit self-modification dashboard (ADR-0247 cycle observability) all referenced as NEW. None exist. Alerts based on these (e.g., last-drill-success age > 2× cadence pages SEV-3 per ADR-0241 §D-7) cannot fire without the dashboards.
top_findings.remediation: Author the 4 dashboard markdown files + matching Grafana/Mimir JSON; wire alert rules into ops-portal.

top_findings.title: Intern day-one runbook is strong; bootstrap-replay log format underspecified
top_findings.evidence: intern-day-one.md is high-quality, 1131 lines, end-to-end testable, with §7 top-15 errors + §8 escalation chain. The only ops-relevant gap: Stage 0.5 bootstrap-replay log file (ADR-0242 §D-5 step 0.5, ADR-0247 §1119) — schema, signing key (before HSM available), storage location not specified.
top_findings.remediation: Add /specs/bootstrap-replay-log-format.json + extend intern-day-one §3 with the file format; minor effort.

top_findings.title: Failure mode 4 (broken rollback-controller) escalation depends on a runbook that does not exist; circular reference
top_findings.evidence: ADR-0247 §D-12 Failure mode 4 escalates to docs/runbooks/oyatie-bootstrap-recovery.md, which is listed as NEW (does not exist). Self-modification doctrine has a circular reference: if everything breaks, follow the recovery runbook we haven't written yet.
top_findings.remediation: Either author oyatie-bootstrap-recovery.md (resolves F9-01 + F9-10 simultaneously) or insert an inline 'until runbook exists, halt-and-call-founding-team' interim instruction in ADR-0247 §D-12.

doctrine_strengths: Bootstrap sequence is the most precisely documented of any operational primitive — Stage 0 → Stage 4 across ADR-0242 + ADR-0247 + ADR-0248 with chicken-and-egg resolutions named.

Static stability (24h Tier 2 isolation tolerance per ADR-0248 §D-8) + constant work (ADR-0248 §D-9 via Brooker 2020) + shuffle sharding (ADR-0248 §D-7 via MacCárthaigh 2014) are hyperscaler-grade and operator-traceable.
Failure mode catalog (ADR-0247 §D-12) is real, named, with severity × scope matrix.
Per-deployment-model SLO matrix (ADR-0254 §D-8) is explicit; air-gapped degraded profile honestly named.
Intern day-one runbook (1131 lines) is a proof point that the operational doctrine is teachable in 8 hours.
Community PRD §12.2 + AC-21 demonstrate the per-PRD ops section pattern works when authored.
Bootstrap cell self-retirement (ADR-0248 §D-2) is the single most operationally novel claim and is documented in 7 sub-steps with audit-chain attestation.
blocking_rationale: F9-Ops verdict is REVISE not REFUSE because the doctrine is operationally sound — the gaps are runbook + dashboard + drill execution debt, not architectural defects. The enforcement_status fields on every ADR ('advisory-until-X-lands') explicitly defer BLOCKER promotion until substrate exists; under that discipline, current state is consistent with the bundle's own admission gates. The bundle should ship as text; the runbook debt (F9-01, F9-02, F9-03 specifically) must close before any keystone validator promotes from advisory to BLOCKER.
recommended_pre_merge_actions: Author /ops/runbooks/oncall-rotation.md naming day-1 responders for the 6 new µservices (resolves F9-03).
Execute bootstrap cell self-retirement tabletop drill + capture receipt artifact in /evidence/ (resolves F9-02).
Insert interim 'halt-and-call-founding-team' guidance in ADR-0247 §D-12 Failure mode 4 until oyatie-bootstrap-recovery.md lands (resolves F9-10 circular reference).
recommended_post_merge_actions: Promote dr_drill_orchestrator.rs out of backlog (P0) or downgrade ADR-0241 §C-1 claim (resolves F9-04).
Author per-PRD ops section template + uplift Mail + Messenger PRDs to Community-PRD-level coverage (resolves F9-05).
Author air-gap bundle delivery + key ceremony runbooks before first IL5/6 customer engagement (resolves F9-07).
Author 4 observability dashboards + wire alerts (resolves F9-08).
Specify bootstrap-replay log format in /specs/ (resolves F9-09).
